name: Enchanted Forest House
summary: Wooden cabin among century-old pines, with a fireplace and valley views.
description: A cozy wooden house surrounded by century-old pine trees, perfect for unplugging. It features a wood-burning fireplace, a terrace with valley views, and direct access to hiking trails.

name: The Old Mill
summary: Restored stone mill by a small stream, with a private garden.
description: A restored old watermill with original stone walls and wooden beams. Set beside a small stream, it offers a private garden and an outdoor barbecue.

name: Altavista Mountain Refuge
summary: Panoramic views of the Picos de Europa, with a private sauna.
description: A hillside rural house with panoramic views of the Picos de Europa mountain range. Ideal for nature lovers, featuring a private sauna and a glazed porch.

name: Los Olivos Farmhouse
summary: Andalusian farmhouse among olive groves, with a private pool and a courtyard fountain.
description: A renovated Andalusian farmhouse surrounded by century-old olive groves, with a private pool and an inner courtyard with a fountain. Perfect for large groups.

name: The Little Lake House
summary: House by a peaceful lake, with its own dock and no mobile signal.
description: A small house by a peaceful lake, with its own dock and a picnic area. A serene setting for total disconnection, with no mobile signal.

name: Can Ferran Farmhouse
summary: 18th-century farmhouse among vineyards, with its own winery and wine tastings.
description: An 18th-century Catalan farmhouse surrounded by vineyards, with its own winery open for visits and wine-tasting sessions included in the stay.
